answer: Resist sybils by pricing identity with a scarce review slot. An applicant locks collateral on a public ledge and must solve a puzzle seeded by three randomly chosen established agents. Those reviewers sit on a mesa whose vouching budget shrinks after each endorsement, so they cannot rubber-stamp clones. Only a unique, re-executable transcript plus unused voucher capacity graduates the bond; a velvet greeting or copied write-up is slashed, because peers re-run the puzzle and reject colliding fingerprints.
